name: Custom Shape Rotating Wooden Bag Chain
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    Crafted from premium-quality wood, this charming bag chain features a durable 3-layer or 4-layer wooden structure (each layer is 3mm thick). It comes with a wire ring for easy attachment—available in black or silver color.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:
- Available in 4 convenient sizes to suit your needs:
3x3 inches ~ 7.62x7.62 cm
4x4 inches ~ 10.16x10.16 cm
5x5 inches ~ 12.7x12.7 cm
6x6 inches ~ 15.24x15.24 cm
- Each piece includes a 155mm long metal wire ring that forms a 50mm diameter loop with 2mm thickness.

- The size of custom shape so the product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Rotating Features:
    Unique rotating flower design—each layer rotates independently to reveal hidden messages or images. A fun and interactive experience with every twist!

 

  • Printing Technology:
    Printed using advanced UV printing technology, ensuring vivid colors and sharp details. The artwork is printed on both sides, making it visually appealing from every angle.

 

  • Functionality & Usage:
    Perfect as a bag charm, keychain, car mirror hanging, or ornamental tag for backpacks, totes, or purses. The rotating function adds a playful and meaningful touch.

 

  • Perfect Gift for All Occasions:
    A thoughtful and customizable gift for anyone, on any occasion—Mother’s Day, birthdays, Christmas, anniversaries, or just to show love. Surprise your loved ones with a heartfelt message hidden within!

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1–3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6–9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xRotating Wooden Bag Chain, 1xWire Ring

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
